newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladeshi tea prices rise on short supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshi tea prices rise on short supply.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose at the weekly auction, mainly on short supply after heavy rains disrupted communications, brokers said on Tuesday.
Brokers said buyers for Poland were active in bidding and lifted mainly bold and large brokens. But buyers for Pakistan and Afghanistan were mostly subdued.
The average price was 72.08 taka per kg, down 0.61 taka from the previous sale. Some 751,655 kg of teas were sold at the auction. The next sale will be held on August 12 with 1.0 million kg.
